column3: Kuroneko Route · Search for Determination
Kyou-chan, how did you spend your holidays? It seems that you were exhausted since morning.
Also, you seem to be scowling...
I'm doing no such thing.
So I'm right. Could it be because of Kuroneko-san?
Her intuition is spot-on...
You didn't contact Kuroneko-san during the holidays?
Well yeah... That girl... Even though I tried very hard to contact her...
I see...
Times like this, it's really great to be in the same school as her and having chances to meet her as long as we're in school.
Hehehe, Kyou-chan is really a capable senpai～
I wouldn't be this tired if I was capable.
I'll support both Kyou-chan and Kuroneko-san!
Really now... Thanks.
Well then, I'm off.
Yeah, good luck!
And so I went to Kuroneko's classroom.
Looks like she isn't around...
Where did she go? Perhaps I should ask around...
Hey you, over there... uhh...
Y-Yes?
Erm, do you know where Kurone-- Gokou went?
I can't possibly call her Kuroneko in front of her classmates...
Gokou-san...?
Umm, she disappeared as soon as the chime rang.
So you don't have any idea where she went?
Yes, sorry...
I see, thanks.
Ah, however...
Eh?
I was told that if a third year senpai were to come, tell him to "never come look for me in this 【Classroom】 again."
T-That girl... She sure has a way to make a fool out of someone.
Why did she tell a fellow classmate that? Won't this cause a misunderstanding?
Good grief... That girl... I absolutely have to get a hold of her.
